name: Help! Ghosts! Party!
source:
Your dream mansion party is at risk. Ghosts and fairies dwell everywhere. They can help you, or doom you. It's up to you.

[From [url=https://selecur.itch.io/help-ghosts-party]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你梦想中的豪宅派对，正面临危机。幽灵与精灵无处不在。它们可能帮你，也可能让你一败涂地。一切取决于你。

[摘自[url=https://selecur.itch.io/help-ghosts-party]itch.io[/url]]
